# September rate hike odds spike after Fed chair speech

Odds of an interest rate hike surged 17 points after Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole inflation warning.

By Danny Gallagher

Aug 29, 2026

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh expressed concern about persistent inflation Friday during his Jackson Hole speech, and Kalshi's September interest rate market jumped following his remarks. [...] The market for the Federal Reserve's September decision shows a 47% chance of a 25-basis-point increase and a 54% chance the Fed will hold rates steady. The hike probability was sitting at 30% before Warsh's remarks.
